name: Utah

agency.name: Utah Division of Oil, Gas and Mining, Department of Natural Resources

form.name: Application for Permit to Drill (APD), with the APD Checklist
form.number: Form 3 (11/2001 edition; blank PDF last modified 2021-04-14); APD Checklist dated 2005-02-08
form.notes: Read the blank Form 3 (items 1 to 25 and the instructions on its back) and the APD Checklist (https://oilgas.ogm.utah.gov/pub/report_forms/APDchecklist.pdf, 19 items). The forms page also lists an ePermit registration form 'for electronic permit and report submittal'; the e-filing screens are login-only and not seen, so the cells follow the paper form and checklist. Form 3 covers drill, reenter and deepen only; recompletions, conversions, plugging and reperforation go on Form 9 Sundry Notices (https://oilgas.ogm.utah.gov/pub/report_forms/Frm_09_2000.pdf, not read).

api_number.n: WellHistory.WellID (10 digits); Wells.API is 14 digits in the file (ReadMe says 10)

permit_number.n: WellHistory.APDNumber, assigned when the APD is received (130 repeats: amended APDs)

lease_name.n: Wells.LeaseNumber (mineral lease no.) and UnitName; no lease name field

operator_name.n: Wells.Operator (current operator, not the one at permit time)

operator_type.n: Form 3 asks operator name, address, phone only; operator registration forms not read

bond.n: Form 3 item 20 Bond description; no bond column in the files seen

district.n: No district item on Form 3; no district column in Wells.csv

surface_latlon.n: Wells.Latitude/Longitude and UTM_Surf_N/E (NAD83); the form asks footages only

surface_plss.n: Wells.QuarterQuarter, Sec, Township, Range, PM, FootageNS/EW

bottom_hole_loc.n: Form 3 item 4 at proposed producing zone; planned survey end point is in DirectionalSurveyData.csv

lateral_path.n: DirectionalSurveyData.csv: MD, inclination, azimuth, offsets; CitingType Planned or AsDrilled

elevation.n: Wells.Ground_Elev (32,025 rows), Kelly_Elev, Floor_Elev; Form 3 item 21

surface_owner.n: Wells.SurfaceOwner = type only (Federal/Indian/State/Fee); owner contact is in the APD packet

well_type.n: Wells.welltype (current type, not as permitted); Form 3 item 1B oil/gas/other

work_type.n: WellHistory.WorkType: DRILL, DEEPEN, REENTER, RECOMP, CONVERT, REPERF, PLUG

well_direction.n: WellHistory.Slant (blank on 35% of rows); Wells.Dir_Horiz/Dir_Vert/Dir_Direct flags

proposed_depth_md.n: Wells.ProposedMD (40,327 of 40,451 rows; in the file, not in the ReadMe); Form 3 item 19

proposed_depth_tvd.n: Wells.ProposedTVD (14,582 rows, mostly directional/horizontal wells; not in ReadMe)

lateral_length.n: No item on Form 3 or the APD checklist; derivable from the planned survey

target_formation.n: APD search shows a Proposed Zone column; not in Wells.csv or WellHistory.csv

formation_tops.n: Estimated tops of geologic markers: drilling program (Form 3 instructions, APD checklist 5)

casing_program.n: Form 3 item 24 (hole size, casing size/grade/weight, setting depth); checklist 11

cement_program.n: Form 3 item 24 (cement type, quantity, yield, slurry weight); checklist 12

pressure_control.n: BOPE specs, schematic and test plan in the drilling plan (checklist 7)

h2s.n: Hydrogen sulfide hazards and contingency plan in the drilling plan (instructions; checklist 10)

pit_waste.n: Not on Form 3 or the APD checklist; federal-lease surface use plans not read

water.n: Evidence of Water Rights approval attached (Form 3 item 25, checklist 4); no volume asked

fracture_plan.n: Not on Form 3 or the APD checklist

spacing_unit.n: Wells.UnitName only; acres assigned (Form 3 item 17) and acres in lease (item 16) not published

spacing_exception.n: Exception location application (checklist 17); Form 3 items 15 and 18 give distances to lease line and nearest well

mineral_owner.n: Wells.LeaseType (Federal/Indian/State/Fee/Multiple) and LeaseNumber; owner type only

fee.n: No fee item on Form 3 or checklist; fee schedule not checked

notice_hearing.n: No notice item on Form 3; exception-location notice rules not read

date_received.n: WellHistory.APDReceivedDate (filled on 27,431 of 52,897 rows; older APDs blank)

date_expires.n: Expiration search: Date Permit Will Expire; file has only APDExtDate and APDRescindDate

completion_date.n: WellHistory.WCRCompletionDate (latest value 2023-11-15, so not current); FirstProdDate

status.n: Wells.wellstatus (NEW, RET, APD, LA, DRL, P, S, TA, PA...); WellHistory.WellStatusReport

plat_image.n: Scanned well file PDF at /wellfiles/<county>/<API10>.pdf; attachments not opened to confirm plat

form_image.n: APD search page: whole permit as PDF since 2018-02-12 (a snapshot; amendments are elsewhere)

completion_report.n: Well Completion search and scanned well files; many completion-report fields are in WellHistory.csv

logs.n: Well Logs search: TIF/PDF/LAS, depth range, date posted; results export to CSV

production_link.n: Wells.TotCum_Oil/Gas/Water; monthly production zips by API on the download page (not opened)

grade_reason: WellHistory.csv is a free, login-free daily bulk CSV with one row per APD and work event, an APDApprovedDate, a WorkType (DRILL, REENTER, DEEPEN...) and a Slant; it joins to Wells.csv (location, operator, county, proposed depth, status). Reachable from here; its yearly counts match the DOGM's own published APDs-by-year totals for 2024 and 2025.
producer_plan: Source: WellHistory.zip (one row per well-construct and work event) joined to Wells.zip on WellID = first 10 digits of API. Both are plain CSVs, a few MB zipped, free, no login, refreshed daily. Monthly approved permits: keep rows with APDApprovedDate not NULL (format MM/DD/YYYY), group by month of APDApprovedDate and WorkType. New drills are WorkType DRILL (about 30-115 a month in 2025-26; 525 in 2025, 712 to Oct 29 2026 incl. one DEEPEN); REENTER and DEEPEN are a handful a year. Horizontal vs vertical from Slant (blank on 35% of rows; falls back to Wells.Dir_Horiz). Operator, county, lat/long, field, lease type, proposed depth and current status come from Wells.csv. Other activity (RECOMP, REPERF, CONVERT, PLUG) has no APD: count it by SundryIntentApprovedDate (sundry notices, a different measure; PLUG about 200-280 a year). APDReceivedDate is filled from about 2000 on (27,431 of 52,897 rows have one), so filing-date counts start there. Approval counts equal the DOGM's own APDs-by-year totals for 2024 and 2025. Caveats: a returned APD (RET, 985 rows) never has an approval date; 130 APD numbers repeat (amendments), so dedupe on APDNumber; Wells.welltype and Operator are the current values, not those at permit time; discard stray dates (one SundryIntentApprovedDate is 2107-10-04); the file has no posting date, so recount the newest weeks on each run.
privacy_notes: Wells.csv and WellHistory.csv have operator names and account numbers and no phone, e-mail or street-address column (0 of 40,451 operator names contain DBA, but sole proprietors were not otherwise checked). Well names are free text and may carry a landowner's surname on fee land (not checked). The scanned APD PDFs hold surface-owner contact details (checklist item 2) and must not be linked or published.
